data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross release of $86.020 million in prior year reserves for underwriting years 2008-2015, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This release represents a 16.30% reduction relative to the opening gross claims outstanding of $527.577 million. However, the report also notes a net deterioration of $9.890 million in the net provision for claims outstanding from previous year-ends, attributed to net claims including IBNR recalibration. The year 2017 saw significant losses from natural catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, impacting Reinsurance, Marine XL, Property XL, Cargo & Specie, and Hull lines, as well as Californian wildfires affecting Property XL. Man-made large losses included a Brazilian plane crash and the sinking of the Stellar Daisy cargo ship and Seikongen fishing vessel.

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net deterioration of $9.890m for prior years on page 11. However, the gross claims development triangle on page 14 indicates a gross release of $86.020m for underwriting years 2008-2015. Following instructions to prioritize gross figures from claims triangles over net narrative, the gross release figure is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m. This implies a significant adverse movement in reinsurance recoveries or other factors that led to a net deterioration despite a gross release. No specific verbatim text for the gross prior year movement was found, so the exact_reserve_text refers to the source table.
